crossRefs.note: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.
translations.bsb: As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the hem of his robe, and it tore.
translations.kjv: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
translations.asv: And as Samuel turned about to go away, Saul laid hold upon the skirt of his robe, and it rent.
